records.trigger: Two concurrent story_advance --phase=DONE processes racing the same story from its own worktree
records.observedFailure: The losing racer crashed with a raw AssertionError wrapping an uncaught Error: File not found: <worktree>/.lattice/story/actives/<storyId>/index.json, instead of a clean explanatory message, because ctx.store (bound to the worktree path at CLI bootstrap) was read after the worktree had already been deleted by the winning DONE.
records.note: Pre-fix: red-B-new-concurrent-done-race.mjs asserted the raw ENOENT crash signature and passed (proving the defect). Post-fix: the same script's own defect-still-present assertion now fails, confirming worktree-authority-smoke.js passes end-to-end.

records.trigger: field-regression-cli-smoke.ts exercised the deliberately-retired lattice-review-channel lane via reviewer_list forceReviewer and via a pass-only finding_add call
records.observedFailure: reviewer_list --forceReviewer=channel was asserted as forceable and finding_add for RP-004 was routed through lattice-review-channel, contradicting prompt-role-contract-registry.ts's hard assertion that lattice-review-channel is status:retired and defaultDispatch:false.
records.note: Pre-fix: red-B-new-retired-channel-lane.mjs asserted the stale channel-lane-forceable behavior and passed (proving the defect). Post-fix: the same script's own defect-still-present assertion now fails, confirming field-regression-cli-smoke.js passes end-to-end with channel rejected and RP-004 routed through lattice-review-test-coverage.
